study_identification_part.si_4_title: Personalizing progressive changes to brain structure in Alzheimer's disease using normative modeling

dc_1_datasets_using_in_this_study.detail: Reference dataset (n=58,836) combined OASIS, ABCD, UKB. Research dataset used ADNI-1, -GO, -2, -3.
dc_1_datasets_using_in_this_study.supporting_text: The reference dataset was made by combining T1-weighted MRI scan data on healthy people from multiple publicly available sources, 19 including Open Access Series of Imaging Studies (OASIS), Adolescent Brain Cognitive Development (ABCD) study, and UK Biobank (UKB)... The research data used in the preparation of this article were obtained from ADNI... from ADNI-1, -GO, -2, and -3

dc_2_purpose_of_each_dataset.detail: Normative models trained on reference datasets (ABCD, UKB, OASIS). ADNI used for transfer learning (calibration) and analysis.
dc_2_purpose_of_each_dataset.supporting_text: a reference (training) dataset comprised of healthy people... including... OASIS... ABCD... and UKB... The distribution parameters of the reference normative model were calibrated to our ADNI dataset using 70% of cognitively unimpaired controls... The data from the remaining 30%... plus participants with MCI and patients with AD, were then compared
